code TypeScript
import express from 'express';
import { createServer as createViteServer } from 'vite';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { GoogleGenAI, Type } from '@google/genai';

dotenv.config();

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const app = express();
const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.use(express.json({ limit: '50mb' }));

// Initialize Google GenAI
const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY,
  httpOptions: {
    headers: {
      'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',
    },
  },
});

// Health check endpoint
app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', time: new Date().toISOString() });
});

// Object Scanner API endpoint
app.post('/api/scan', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { image, mimeType = 'image/jpeg' } = req.body;

    if (!image) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Nta foto yatanzwe (No image provided)' });
    }

    // Clean base64 data if it contains data URI prefix
    let cleanBase64 = image;
    let detectedMime = mimeType;
    if (image.startsWith('data:')) {
      const matches = image.match(/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      if (matches) {
        detectedMime = matches[1];
        cleanBase64 = matches[2];
      }
    }

    const imagePart = {
      inlineData: {
        mimeType: detectedMime,
        data: cleanBase64,
      },
    };

    const promptText = `
Wowe uri umuhanga mu gusikana no kumenya ibintu (AI Vision Object Recognition Expert) no mu rurimi rw'IKINYARWANDA nyacyo (native standard Rwandan Kinyarwanda).
Reba neza iyi foto igaragazwa n'akamera ya scanner.
Kora ibi bikurikira:
1. Menya ikintu nyamukuru (main object) kiri hagati cyangwa gikomeye mu foto umuntu yerekejeho camera.
2. Tanga izina ryacyo nyaryo mu Kinyarwanda (nameRw) - urugero: "Ikaramu", "Igikombe cy'icyayi", "Telefoni igendanwa", "Imashini ya mudasobwa", "Ururabo", "Inyanya", "Igitoki", "Amadarubindi", "Intebe", "Ameza", "Isumo", "Ingagi", "Imodoka", "Agaseke", n'ibindi.
3. Tanga izina mu Cyongereza (nameEn) no mu Gifaransa (nameFr).
4. Tanga uko bivugwa / imivugirwe (pronunciation) mu Kinyarwanda kugira ngo byorohe kubisoma neza (urugero: "i-ka-ra-mu").
5. Tanga interuro iboneye kandi isobanutse mu Kinyarwanda igomba gusomwa n'ijwi (spokenSentence), urugero: "Iki ni igikombe cy'amazi gikoreshwa mu kunywa." cyangwa "Iyi ni ikaramu ikoreshwa mu kwandika ku mpapuro."
6. Tanga icyiciro ikintu giherereyemo (category) mu Kinyarwanda, urugero: "Ibikoresho byo mu biro", "Ibiribwa n'Ibinyobwa", "Ibikoresho byo mu rugo", "Ikoranabuhanga", "Imyambaro", "Ibimera n'Inyamaswa", "Ibinyabiziga", n'ibindi.
7. Tanga ibisobanuro birambuye mu Kinyarwanda (descriptionRw) ku mikoreshereze n'akamaro kacyo.
8. Tanga amakuru y'inyongera cyangwa umwihariko mu muco n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi mu Rwanda (culturalNote).
9. Tanga urutonde rw'ibindi bintu bito biboneka mu mpande (secondaryItems) mu Kinyarwanda.
10. Tanga igipimo cy'icyizere (confidence: 0-100).

Subiza mu buryo bwa JSON bwuzuye hakurikijwe schema.
`;

    const textPart = { text: promptText };
    const modelsToTry = ['gemini-3.8-flash', 'gemini-flash-latest'];
    let lastError: any = null;
    let responseText: string | null = null;

    for (const modelName of modelsToTry) {
      try {
        const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
          model: modelName,
          contents: { parts: [imagePart, textPart] },
          config: {
            responseMimeType: 'application/json',
            responseSchema: {
              type: Type.OBJECT,
              properties: {
                nameRw: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Izina ry'ikintu mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo (Name in Kinyarwanda)",
                },
                nameEn: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: 'Izina mu Cyongereza (Name in English)',
                },
                nameFr: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: 'Izina mu Gifaransa (Name in French)',
                },
                pronunciation: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Imivugirwe y'izina ry'ikintu (Phonetic pronunciation guide)",
                },
                spokenSentence: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Interuro iboneye mu Kinyarwanda yo kuvuga mu majwi (Sentence to speak aloud)",
                },
                category: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Icyiciro ikintu kirimo (Category in Kinyarwanda)",
                },
                descriptionRw: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Ibisobanuro birambuye by'ikintu mu Kinyarwanda",
                },
                culturalNote: {
                  type: Type.STRING,
                  description: "Amakuru y'umwihariko mu Rwanda cyangwa inama y'imikoreshereze mu Kinyarwanda",
                },
                confidence: {
                  type: Type.NUMBER,
                  description: "Ijanisha ry'icyizere (0-100)",
                },
                secondaryItems: {
                  type: Type.ARRAY,
                  items: { type: Type.STRING },
                  description: "Ibindi bintu biboneka mu foto mu Kinyarwanda",
                },
              },
              required: [
                'nameRw',
                'nameEn',
                'nameFr',
                'pronunciation',
                'spokenSentence',
                'category',
                'descriptionRw',
                'confidence',
              ],
            },
          },
        });

        if (response.text) {
          responseText = response.text;
          break;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        lastError = err;
        console.warn(`Model ${modelName} failed or busy, trying next:`, err?.message || err);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
      }
    }

    if (!responseText) {
      throw lastError || new Error('Ntabwo serivisi ya AI yabashije gusubiza ubu.');
    }

    const resultJson = JSON.parse(responseText);
    if (!resultJson) {
      return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Ntabwo bishobotse gusobanura ifoto (Failed to parse result)' });
    }

    return res.json({
      success: true,
      data: resultJson,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Scan error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      error: error?.message || 'Habaye ikosa mugihe cyo gusikana ifoto',
    });
  }
});

// Text-to-Speech API endpoint
app.post('/api/speak', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { text, voice = 'Kore' } = req.body;

    if (!text) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Nta magambo yatanzwe yo kuvuga' });
    }

    let base64Audio: string | undefined;

    try {
      const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
        model: 'gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts',
        contents: text,
        config: {
          responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
        },
      });

      base64Audio =
        response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData?.data;
    } catch (ttsErr: any) {
      console.warn('Primary TTS model error, trying fallback:', ttsErr?.message);
    }

    if (base64Audio) {
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        audioMime: 'audio/wav',
        audioData: `data:audio/wav;base64,${base64Audio}`,
      });
    } else {
      return res.json({
        success: false,
        fallbackText: text,
        message: 'No audio returned by TTS model',
      });
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn('TTS error (will fallback to browser Web Speech API):', error?.message);
    return res.json({
      success: false,
      fallbackText: req.body?.text || '',
      error: error?.message,
    });
  }
});

// Start server
async function startServer() {
  const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

  if (!isProduction) {
    const vite = await createViteServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: 'spa',
    });
    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  } else {
    app.use(express.static(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist')));
    app.get('*', (req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'));
    });
  }

  app.listen(port, () => {
    console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${port}`);
  });
}

startServer();

code TypeScript
/**
 * Audio playback utility for Kinyarwanda pronunciation
 * Integrates Gemini TTS with graceful Web Speech fallback
 */

let activeAudioElement: HTMLAudioElement | null = null;

export async function fetchAndPlayKinyarwandaSpeech(
  text: string,
  onStart?: () => void,
  onEnd?: () => void,
  onError?: (err: any) => void,
  voiceName: string = 'Kore',
  playbackRate: number = 1.0
): Promise<string | null> {
  stopAllAudio();

  try {
    if (onStart) onStart();

    // Call server-side Gemini TTS
    const response = await fetch('/api/speak', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ text, voice: voiceName }),
    });

    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.success && data.audioData) {
        const audio = new Audio(data.audioData);
        audio.playbackRate = playbackRate;
        activeAudioElement = audio;

        audio.onended = () => {
          activeAudioElement = null;
          if (onEnd) onEnd();
        };

        audio.onerror = (e) => {
          console.warn('Audio playback error, falling back to speech synthesis:', e);
          fallbackWebSpeech(text, onEnd, onError, playbackRate);
        };

        await audio.play();
        return data.audioData;
      }
    }

    // Fallback if backend TTS was unavailable
    fallbackWebSpeech(text, onEnd, onError, playbackRate);
    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to call /api/speak, using Web Speech API fallback:', err);
    fallbackWebSpeech(text, onEnd, onError, playbackRate);
    return null;
  }
}

export function stopAllAudio() {
  if (activeAudioElement) {
    activeAudioElement.pause();
    activeAudioElement.currentTime = 0;
    activeAudioElement = null;
  }
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  }
}

function fallbackWebSpeech(
  text: string,
  onEnd?: () => void,
  onError?: (err: any) => void,
  rate: number = 1.0
) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('speechSynthesis' in window)) {
    if (onEnd) onEnd();
    return;
  }

  try {
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    utterance.rate = rate * 0.92;
    utterance.pitch = 1.0;

    const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
    const rwVoice =
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.startsWith('rw')) ||
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.startsWith('sw')) ||
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.startsWith('fr')) ||
      voices.find((v) => v.lang.startsWith('en'));

    if (rwVoice) {
      utterance.voice = rwVoice;
    }

    utterance.onend = () => {
      if (onEnd) onEnd();
    };

    utterance.onerror = (e) => {
      console.warn('Speech synthesis utterance error:', e);
      if (onError) onError(e);
      if (onEnd) onEnd();
    };

    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Speech synthesis execution failed:', e);
    if (onError) onError(e);
    if (onEnd) onEnd();
  }
}

import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Camera,
  RotateCcw,
  Upload,
  Zap,
  ZapOff,
  AlertCircle,
  Eye,
  RefreshCw,
  Sliders,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SAMPLE_OBJECTS } from '../data/samples';
import { SampleObject } from '../types';

interface CameraScannerProps {
  onCaptureImage: (imageBase64: string, sourceName?: string) => void;
  isScanning: boolean;
  autoScanEnabled: boolean;
  setAutoScanEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
}

export const CameraScanner: React.FC<CameraScannerProps> = ({
  onCaptureImage,
  isScanning,
  autoScanEnabled,
  setAutoScanEnabled,
}) => {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [facingMode, setFacingMode] = useState<'environment' | 'user'>('environment');
  const [hasTorch, setHasTorch] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [torchOn, setTorchOn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [shutterFlash, setShutterFlash] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cameraLoading, setCameraLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const startCamera = useCallback(async (facing: 'environment' | 'user') => {
    setCameraLoading(true);
    setCameraError(null);

    if (stream) {
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
    }

    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error("Mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni yawe ntabwo ifite uburyo bwo gufata amashusho ya camera muri ubu buryo.");
      }

      const newStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: { ideal: facing },
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });

      setStream(newStream);

      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = newStream;
        await videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      const track = newStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
      if (track) {
        const capabilities = (track.getCapabilities && track.getCapabilities()) as any;
        if (capabilities && 'torch' in capabilities) {
          setHasTorch(true);
        } else {
          setHasTorch(false);
        }
      }
      setCameraLoading(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Camera initialization error:', err);
      setCameraLoading(false);
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError' || err.name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
        setCameraError(
          "Uruhushya rwa camera ntirwatanzwe. Kanda 'Emeza' kuri camera cyangwa ukoreshe uburyo bwo gushyiramo ifoto ibitse."
        );
      } else {
        setCameraError(
          "Camera ntibonetse cyangwa iri gukoreshwa n'indi porogaramu. Ushobora gukoresha ibyitegererezo biri hasi cyangwa ugashyiramo ifoto."
        );
      }
    }
  }, [stream]);

  useEffect(() => {
    startCamera(facingMode);
    return () => {
      if (stream) {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }
    };
  }, [facingMode]);

  const toggleFacingMode = () => {
    const nextMode = facingMode === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment';
    setFacingMode(nextMode);
  };

  const toggleTorch = async () => {
    if (!stream) return;
    const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (track) {
      try {
        const nextState = !torchOn;
        await (track as any).applyConstraints({
          advanced: [{ torch: nextState }],
        });
        setTorchOn(nextState);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Torch constraint failed:', err);
      }
    }
  };

  const captureFrame = useCallback(() => {
    if (!videoRef.current || isScanning) return;

    setShutterFlash(true);
    setTimeout(() => setShutterFlash(false), 200);

    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.vibrate) {
      navigator.vibrate(40);
    }

    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current || document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);
      onCaptureImage(dataUrl, 'Camera Live');
    }
  }, [isScanning, onCaptureImage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    if (autoScanEnabled && !isScanning && !cameraError && stream) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        captureFrame();
      }, 7000);
    }
    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [autoScanEnabled, isScanning, cameraError, stream, captureFrame]);

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const dataUrl = event.target?.result as string;
      if (dataUrl) {
        onCaptureImage(dataUrl, file.name);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleSelectSample = (sample: SampleObject) => {
    onCaptureImage(sample.imageUrl, sample.titleRw);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div className="relative w-full aspect-[4/3] sm:aspect-[16/10] md:aspect-[16/9] max-h-[580px] bg-slate-950 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center">
        {shutterFlash && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white z-30 pointer-events-none animate-ping opacity-75" />
        )}

        {!cameraError ? (
          <video
            ref={videoRef}
            playsInline
            autoPlay
            muted
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
        ) : null}

        <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

        {cameraLoading && !cameraError && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-300 gap-3">
            <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-400 animate-spin" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Camera iri gutegurwa...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {cameraError && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900 z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400 mb-3">
              <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-1">
              Camera Ntibonetse
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mb-5 leading-relaxed">
              {cameraError}
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => startCamera(facingMode)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Gerageza Nanone</span>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Shyiramo Ifoto Ibitse</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {!cameraError && !cameraLoading && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-10 flex flex-col justify-between p-4 sm:p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-white/90">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span className="font-medium text-emerald-300">
                  {isScanning ? "Gusikana..." : autoScanEnabled ? "Auto-Scan Yaka" : "EREKEZA KU KINTU"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="text-xs text-slate-300 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 hidden sm:block">
                <span>{facingMode === 'environment' ? 'Camera y’Inyuma' : 'Camera y’Imbere'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="relative self-center w-64 h-64 sm:w-80 sm:h-80 max-w-[85vw] max-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-emerald-400" />
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-emerald-400" />
              <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-8 h-8 border-b-2 border-l-2 border-emerald-400" />
              <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-8 h-8 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-emerald-400" />

              <div className="w-4 h-4 border border-emerald-400/70 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <div className="w-1 h-1 bg-emerald-400 rounded-full" />
              </div>

              <div
                className={`absolute left-2 right-2 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-emerald-400 to-transparent shadow-[0_0_12px_#34d399] transition-all duration-700 ${
                  isScanning ? 'animate-bounce' : 'animate-pulse'
                }`}
                style={{
                  top: '50%',
                  transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                }}
              />

              <div className="absolute -bottom-8 text-center w-full">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide text-slate-200/90 bg-slate-950/70 px-2.5 py-1 rounded backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/10">
                  {isScanning ? "AI iri gusuzuma ikintu mu Kinyarwanda..." : "Shyira ikintu hagati y’ikiranga"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300">
              <span className="bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 text-[11px]">
                Imboni AI Scanner
              </span>
              <span className="bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 text-[11px]">
                Kinyarwanda Object ID
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleFacingMode}
            title="Hindura camera (imbere / inyuma)"
            className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>

          {hasTorch && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={toggleTorch}
              title={torchOn ? "Zimya urumuri" : "Fungura urumuri rwa camera"}
              className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
                torchOn
                  ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 border-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-700 text-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              {torchOn ? <Zap className="w-5 h-5 fill-current" /> : <ZapOff className="w-5 h-5" />}
            </button>
          )}

          <input
            type="file"
            ref={fileInputRef}
            accept="image/*"
            onChange={handleFileUpload}

          <button

            title="Hitamo ifoto ibitse muri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa"
            className="h-11 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"

            <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />

              isScanning
                ? 'bg-slate-800 cursor-not-allowed border-2 border-slate-700'
                : 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 border-4 border-slate-900 shadow-emerald-500/25 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/50'
            }`}
          >
            {isScanning ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              </div>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setAutoScanEnabled(!autoScanEnabled)}
            className={`h-11 px-3.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              autoScanEnabled
                ? 'bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
                : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-700 text-slate-300'
            }`}
          >
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Auto-Sikana (7s):</span>
            <span className="font-semibold">{autoScanEnabled ? 'Yaka' : 'Zimije'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-slate-200">
            <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Gerageza Ako Kanya (Ibyitegererezo by'Ibintu):</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 hidden sm:inline">

          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-8 gap-2.5">
          {SAMPLE_OBJECTS.map((sample) => (

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Volume2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Sparkles,
  Info,
  Layers,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ScanResult } from '../types';

interface ScanResultCardProps {
  result: ScanResult;
  onPlayAudio: (text: string, slow?: boolean) => void;
  isPlayingAudio: boolean;
  onScanAnother?: () => void;
}

export const ScanResultCard: React.FC<ScanResultCardProps> = ({
  result,
  onPlayAudio,
  isPlayingAudio,
  onScanAnother,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [slowMode, setSlowMode] = useState(false);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${result.nameRw} - ${result.spokenSentence}`);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const formattedTime = new Date(result.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/40">

            referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

          <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
            {Math.round(result.confidence)}% icyizere
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="md:col-span-8 p-5 sm:p-7 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-400 mb-2">
              <span className="font-medium text-emerald-400">{result.category}</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>{result.nameEn}</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>{result.nameFr}</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">{formattedTime}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap">
              <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
                {result.nameRw}
              </h2>
              {result.pronunciation && (
                <span className="text-sm font-mono text-emerald-300/80 bg-emerald-950/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/20">
                  [{result.pronunciation}]
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-base text-slate-200 leading-relaxed font-normal bg-slate-800/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/50">
              "{result.spokenSentence}"
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPlayAudio(result.spokenSentence, slowMode)}
              className={`h-12 px-6 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-3 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-md cursor-pointer ${
                isPlayingAudio
                  ? 'bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 ring-4 ring-emerald-500/30 animate-pulse'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 shadow-emerald-500/20'
              }`}
            >
              <Volume2 className="w-5 h-5" />
              <span>
                {isPlayingAudio ? "Ijwi riri kuvuga..." : "Umva Imvugo mu Kinyarwanda"}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                const next = !slowMode;
                setSlowMode(next);
                onPlayAudio(result.nameRw, next);
              }}
              title="Vuga izina gahoro gahoro kugira ngo wumve neza ibice by'ijambo"
              className={`h-12 px-4 rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                slowMode
                  ? 'bg-amber-950/50 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 border-slate-700 text-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <span>{slowMode ? 'Umuvuduko: Gahoro (0.8x)' : 'Vuga Gahoro'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="h-12 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span>{copied ? 'Byakoporowe!' : 'Koporora'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="p-5 sm:p-7 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 bg-slate-900/60">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Ibisobanuro by'Ikintu</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
            {result.descriptionRw}
          </p>
        </div>

        {result.culturalNote && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
              <span>Umuco n'Imikoreshereze mu Rwanda</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
              {result.culturalNote}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {result.secondaryItems && result.secondaryItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="md:col-span-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 mb-2">
              <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Ibindi bibonetse mu foto:</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-300">
              {result.secondaryItems.map((item, idx) => (
                <React.Fragment key={idx}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onPlayAudio(item)}
                    className="hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors font-medium underline underline-offset-4 decoration-slate-700 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {item}
                  </button>
                  {idx < result.secondaryItems!.length - 1 && (
                    <span className="text-slate-600" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                  )}
                </React.Fragment>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {onScanAnother && (
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-950/80 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Kanda kuri camera hejuru cyangwa buto yo gusikana ikindi kintu.
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={onScanAnother}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>Sikana Ikindi Kintu</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  History,
  Trash2,
  Search,
  Volume2,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ScanResult } from '../types';

interface ScanHistoryProps {
  history: ScanResult[];
  onSelectResult: (result: ScanResult) => void;
  onClearHistory: () => void;
  onDeleteResult: (id: string) => void;
  onPlayAudio: (text: string) => void;
  isPlayingAudio: boolean;
}

export const ScanHistory: React.FC<ScanHistoryProps> = ({
  history,
  onSelectResult,
  onClearHistory,
  onDeleteResult,
  onPlayAudio,
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');

  const categories = ['All', ...Array.from(new Set(history.map((h) => h.category)))];

  const filteredHistory = history.filter((item) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      item.nameRw.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.nameEn.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.spokenSentence.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory =
      selectedCategory === 'All' || item.category === selectedCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xl">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-6 border-b border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <History className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
              Ububiko bw'Ibyasikanywe
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Urutonde rw'ibintu byose wasikanye n'amazina yabyo mu Kinyarwanda
          </p>
        </div>

        {history.length > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={onClearHistory}
            className="text-xs font-medium text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-950/20 hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start sm:self-center cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Gusiba Byose</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {history.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 mb-4">
            <History className="w-7 h-7" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-1">
            Nta kintu kirasikanwa
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-sm">
            Erekeza camera ku kintu icyo aricyo cyose cyangwa ukande kuri kimwe mu byitegererezo kugira ngo usikane ugasoma amazina mu Kinyarwanda.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Shakisha mu byasikanywe..."
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>

            {categories.length > 2 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
                {categories.map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      selectedCategory === cat
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cat === 'All' ? 'Byose' : cat}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-2">
            {filteredHistory.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="group relative bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all"
              >
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center p-1">
                    <img
                      src={item.imageUrl}
                      alt={item.nameRw}
                      className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                      referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-0.5">
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium truncate">{item.category}</span>
                      <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
                        {new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-white truncate">
                      {item.nameRw}
                    </h4>

                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate">
                      {item.nameEn} · {item.nameFr}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300 line-clamp-2 bg-slate-900/50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/60 font-light">
                  "{item.spokenSentence}"
                </p>

                <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onPlayAudio(item.spokenSentence)}
                    className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Umva</span>
                  </button>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onSelectResult(item)}
                      title="Reba amakuru yose"
                      className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>Reba</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onDeleteResult(item.id)}
                      title="Siba iki gusa"
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-950/40 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  BookOpen,
  Search,
  Volume2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { VOCABULARY_LIST } from '../data/vocabulary';

interface VocabularyExplorerProps {
  onPlayAudio: (text: string) => void;
  playingWordText: string | null;
}

export const VocabularyExplorer: React.FC<VocabularyExplorerProps> = ({
  onPlayAudio,
  playingWordText,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');

  const categories = [
    'All',
    'Ibikoresho byo mu rugo',
    'Ikoranabuhanga',
    'Ibikoresho byo mu biro',
    "Ibiribwa n'Ibinyobwa",
    'Amatungo n’Inyamaswa',
    'Ibimera n’Indabyo',
    'Ibinyabiziga',
    'Umuco n’Ubukorikori',
    'Imyambaro',
  ];

  const filtered = VOCABULARY_LIST.filter((word) => {
    const matchesCategory =
      selectedCategory === 'All' || word.category === selectedCategory;
    const matchesSearch =
      word.rw.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      word.en.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      word.fr.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      word.exampleSentence.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xl">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-6 border-b border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
              Inkoranyamagambo y'Ibintu mu Kinyarwanda
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Wige uko ibintu bitandukanye byitwa, uko bivugwa, n'interuro zabyo mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-950 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 self-start sm:self-center font-mono">
          Amagambo {filtered.length} kuri {VOCABULARY_LIST.length}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Shakisha ijambo mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa..."
            className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none">
          {categories.map((cat) => (
            <button
              key={cat}
              onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${
                selectedCategory === cat
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-750'
              }`}
            >
              {cat === 'All' ? 'Byose' : cat}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-6">
        {filtered.map((word) => {
          const isPlayingThis = playingWordText === word.exampleSentence || playingWordText === word.rw;
          return (
            <div
              key={word.id}
              className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800/80 hover:border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between transition-colors"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium truncate">{word.category}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
                    [{word.pronunciation}]
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  {word.rw}
                </h3>

                <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  <span className="text-slate-300">{word.en}</span>
                  <span className="mx-1.5 text-slate-600">·</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-400">{word.fr}</span>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed bg-slate-900/60 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/60">
                  "{word.exampleSentence}"
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPlayAudio(word.exampleSentence)}
                  className={`h-8 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
                    isPlayingThis
                      ? 'bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 ring-2 ring-emerald-400/30'
                      : 'bg-emerald-950/60 hover:bg-emerald-900/70 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isPlayingThis ? "Iri kuvuga..." : "Umva Imvugo"}</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPlayAudio(word.rw)}
                  className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Izina Gusa
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">·</span>
            <span>
              <strong>Urumuri Ruhagije:</strong> Gerageza gushyira ikintu aho hari urumuri runoza ifoto neza.
            </span>
          </li>
          <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">·</span>
            <span>
              <strong>Igikoresho Kimwe:</strong> Niba ushaka kumenya ikaramu cyangwa igikombe, kigire hafi y'akamera.
            </span>
          </li>
          <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">·</span>
            <span>
              <strong>Hindura Camera:</strong> Koresha camera y'inyuma ku matelefoni kugira ngo biborohere kuyerekeza ku bintu.
            </span>
          </li>
          <li className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">·</span>
            <span>
              <strong>Ibyitegererezo:</strong> Niba udafite camera ifunguye ubu, kanda ku mafoto y'ibyitegererezo ari hasi.
            </span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div className="text-center pt-2">
        <button
          onClick={onStartScanning}
          className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold text-sm rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 active:scale-95 transition-all inline-flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Tangira Gusikana Nonaha</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

code TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Header } from './components/Header';
import { CameraScanner } from './components/CameraScanner';
import { ScanResultCard } from './components/ScanResultCard';
import { ScanHistory } from './components/ScanHistory';
import { VocabularyExplorer } from './components/VocabularyExplorer';
import { UserGuide } from './components/UserGuide';
import { ScanResult } from './types';
import { fetchAndPlayKinyarwandaSpeech, stopAllAudio } from './utils/audioPlayer';
import { Sparkles, AlertCircle, Volume2 } from 'lucide-react';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'imboni_scanner_history_v1';

export default function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'scanner' | 'history' | 'vocabulary' | 'guide'>('scanner');
  const [currentResult, setCurrentResult] = useState<ScanResult | null>(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<ScanResult[]>([]);
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [autoSpeak, setAutoSpeak] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [autoScanEnabled, setAutoScanEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPlayingAudio, setIsPlayingAudio] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [playingText, setPlayingText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [scanError, setScanError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        setHistory(JSON.parse(saved));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not load history from localStorage:', e);
    }
  }, []);

  const saveHistory = (newHistory: ScanResult[]) => {
    setHistory(newHistory);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(newHistory));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not save history to localStorage:', e);
    }
  };

  const handlePlayAudio = (text: string, slow: boolean = false) => {
    if (!text) return;
    setPlayingText(text);
    setIsPlayingAudio(true);

    fetchAndPlayKinyarwandaSpeech(
      text,
      () => {
        setIsPlayingAudio(true);
      },
      () => {
        setIsPlayingAudio(false);
        setPlayingText(null);
      },
      (err) => {
        console.warn('Playback error:', err);
        setIsPlayingAudio(false);
        setPlayingText(null);
      },
      'Kore',
      slow ? 0.8 : 1.0
    );
  };

  const handleCaptureImage = async (imageBase64: string, sourceName?: string) => {
    if (isScanning) return;

    setIsScanning(true);
    setScanError(null);
    stopAllAudio();

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/scan', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          image: imageBase64,
          mimeType: 'image/jpeg',
        }),
      });

      const json = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok || !json.success) {
        throw new Error(json.error || 'Ntibishobotse kumenya ikintu kiri mu ifoto');
      }

      const data = json.data;
      const scanItem: ScanResult = {
        id: `scan_${Date.now()}`,
        nameRw: data.nameRw || 'Ikintu Kitazwi',
        nameEn: data.nameEn || '',
        nameFr: data.nameFr || '',
        pronunciation: data.pronunciation || '',
        spokenSentence: data.spokenSentence || `${data.nameRw} yagaragaye.`,
        category: data.category || 'Ibikoresho',
        descriptionRw: data.descriptionRw || '',
        culturalNote: data.culturalNote || '',
        confidence: data.confidence || 90,
        secondaryItems: data.secondaryItems || [],
        imageUrl: imageBase64,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      setCurrentResult(scanItem);

      const updatedHistory = [scanItem, ...history.slice(0, 49)];
      saveHistory(updatedHistory);

      if (autoSpeak) {
        handlePlayAudio(scanItem.spokenSentence);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Scan error:', err);
      setScanError(
        err?.message ||
          'Habaye ikosa mugihe cyo gusesengura ifoto. Gerageza kongera gusikana neza ahari urumuri ruhagije.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClearHistory = () => {
    if (window.confirm("Urashaka gusiba ibyasikanywe byose mu bubiko?")) {
      saveHistory([]);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteResult = (id: string) => {
    const next = history.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
    saveHistory(next);
    if (currentResult?.id === id) {
      setCurrentResult(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-emerald-500 selection:text-slate-950">
      <Header
        activeTab={activeTab}
        setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
        autoSpeak={autoSpeak}
        setAutoSpeak={setAutoSpeak}
        onTriggerScan={() => {
          const event = new CustomEvent('manual-trigger-scan');
          window.dispatchEvent(event);
        }}
        scanCount={history.length}
      />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-8 flex flex-col gap-8">
        {scanError && (
          <div className="bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-200 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between text-xs gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{scanError}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setScanError(null)}
              className="text-rose-400 hover:text-white font-semibold underline text-[11px] cursor-pointer"
            >
              Funga
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'scanner' && (
          <div className="space-y-8">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
              <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col gap-4">
                <CameraScanner
                  onCaptureImage={handleCaptureImage}
                  isScanning={isScanning}
                  autoScanEnabled={autoScanEnabled}
                  setAutoScanEnabled={setAutoScanEnabled}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4">
                {currentResult ? (
                  <ScanResultCard
                    result={currentResult}
                    onPlayAudio={handlePlayAudio}
                    isPlayingAudio={isPlayingAudio}
                    onScanAnother={() => {
                      setCurrentResult(null);
                    }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-7 flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 shadow-xl h-full min-h-[460px]">
                    <div>
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
                        <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6" />
                      </div>

                      <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight mb-2">
                        Erekeza Camera ku Kintu Icyo Aricyo Cyose
                      </h2>

                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed mb-5">
                        Porogaramu ya Imboni Scanner irahita imenya icyo kintu, igisome, kinavugwe mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo mu buryo bw'amajwi.
                      </p>

                      <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-400">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">1.</span>
                          <span>
                            <strong>Gusikana Ako Kanya:</strong> Kanda kuri buto y'icyatsi cyangwa ukande ku kintu cy'icyitegererezo.
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">2.</span>
                          <span>
                            <strong>Ijwi ry'Ikinyarwanda:</strong> Porogaramu izasoma izina n'interuro ifite imvugo iboneye.
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">3.</span>
                          <span>
                            <strong>Amagambo n'Ubumenyi:</strong> Wige izina mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n'Igifaransa hamwe n'umuco w'u Rwanda.
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-slate-950/70 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-300">
                        <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                        <span>Imvugo y'Ijwi:</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                        {autoSpeak ? 'Rirahita Rivuga Ako Kanya' : 'Rirategereje'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {history.length > 0 && (
              <div className="border-t border-slate-800/80 pt-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200">
                    Ibiheruka Gusikanwa
                  </h3>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
                    className="text-xs text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Reba Byose ({history.length})
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
                  {history.slice(0, 6).map((item) => (
                    <button
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => setCurrentResult(item)}
                      className="group bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left flex flex-col gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <div className="aspect-square bg-slate-950 rounded-lg overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center p-1 border border-slate-800/60">
                        <img
                          src={item.imageUrl}
                          alt={item.nameRw}
                          className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate group-hover:text-emerald-400">
                          {item.nameRw}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                          {item.nameEn}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'history' && (
          <ScanHistory
            history={history}
            onSelectResult={(item) => {
              setCurrentResult(item);
              setActiveTab('scanner');
            }}
            onClearHistory={handleClearHistory}
            onDeleteResult={handleDeleteResult}
            onPlayAudio={handlePlayAudio}
            isPlayingAudio={isPlayingAudio}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'vocabulary' && (
          <VocabularyExplorer
            onPlayAudio={handlePlayAudio}
            playingWordText={playingText}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'guide' && (
          <UserGuide onStartScanning={() => setActiveTab('scanner')} />
        )}
      </main>

      <footer className="border-t border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-950 py-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-center sm:text-left">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Imboni Scanner</span>
            <span>·</span>
            <span>Gusikana ibintu bikavugwa mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-slate-400">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('scanner')}
              className="hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Camera
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('vocabulary')}
              className="hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Amagambo
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('guide')}
              className="hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Ubufasha
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
