                <button onclick="document.getElementById('file-upload').click()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer">Shyiramo Ifoto</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Ikiranga cy'Icyatsi n'Umuhora wa Laser -->
            <div class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-10 flex flex-col justify-between p-4 sm:p-6">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-white/90">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                  <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span>
                  <span class="font-medium text-emerald-300" id="scan-hud-status">EREKEZA KU KINTU</span>
                </div>
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-300 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 hidden sm:block" id="camera-facing-label">
                  Camera y’Inyuma
                </span>
              </div>

              <!-- Reticle Frame -->
              <div class="relative self-center w-64 h-64 sm:w-72 sm:h-72 max-w-[85vw] max-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center">
                <div class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-emerald-400"></div>
                <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-emerald-400"></div>
                <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-8 h-8 border-b-2 border-l-2 border-emerald-400"></div>
                <div class="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-8 h-8 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-emerald-400"></div>

                <div class="w-4 h-4 border border-emerald-400/70 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                  <div class="w-1 h-1 bg-emerald-400 rounded-full"></div>
                </div>

                <!-- Animated Laser beam -->
                <div class="absolute left-2 right-2 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-emerald-400 to-transparent shadow-[0_0_12px_#34d399] animate-scan-beam"></div>

                <div class="absolute -bottom-7 text-center w-full">
                  <span class="text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide text-slate-200/90 bg-slate-950/70 px-2.5 py-1 rounded backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/10" id="reticle-hint">
                    Shyira ikintu hagati y’ikiranga
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300">
                <span class="bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 text-[11px]">Imboni Scanner</span>
                <span class="bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 text-[11px]">Kinyarwanda Voice</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Buto zo hasi (Shutter & Auto-Scan) -->
          <div class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button onclick="toggleCameraFacing()" title="Hindura Camera" class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"/></svg>
              </button>

              <input type="file" id="file-upload" accept="image/*" class="hidden" onchange="handleFileUpload(event)" />
              <button onclick="document.getElementById('file-upload').click()" class="h-11 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12"/></svg>
                <span class="hidden sm:inline">Shyiramo Ifoto</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Shutter Button nini -->
            <button onclick="captureAndScan()" id="shutter-btn" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 border-4 border-slate-900 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/25 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/50 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 transition-transform cursor-pointer">
              <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" stroke-width="2"/><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 9a2 2 0 012-2h.93a2 2 0 001.664-.89l.812-1.22A2 2 0 0110.07 4h3.86a2 2 0 011.664.89l.812 1.22A2 2 0 0018.07 7H19a2 2 0 012 2v9a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V9z"/></svg>
              </div>
            </button>

            <!-- Auto-scan toggle (Gusikana buri masegonda 6 mu buryo bwikora) -->
            <button onclick="toggleAutoScan()" id="auto-scan-btn" class="h-11 px-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <span>Auto-Sikana (6s):</span>
              <span id="auto-scan-state" class="font-bold text-slate-400">Zimije</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <!-- Ibyitegererezo by'Ako Kanya (Samples) -->
          <div class="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-slate-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z"/></svg>
                <span>Gerageza Ako Kanya (Ibyitegererezo):</span>
              </div>
              <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 hidden sm:inline">Kanda kugira ngo cyitwe kinavugwe</span>
            </div>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-8 gap-2" id="samples-container"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Iburyo: Ibisubizo by'Ibyasikanywe n'Ijwi ry'Ikinyarwanda -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div id="result-container" class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-7 flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 shadow-xl min-h-[460px]">
            <!-- Ikaze bwa mbere -->
            <div id="welcome-box">
              <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
                <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 3v4M3 5h4M6 17v4m-2-2h4m5-16l2.286 6.857L21 12l-5.714 2.143L13 21l-2.286-6.857L5 12l5.714-2.143L13 3z"/></svg>
              </div>

              <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight mb-2">
                Erekeza Camera ku Kintu Icyo Aricyo Cyose
              </h2>

              <p class="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed mb-5">
                Porogaramu ya Imboni Scanner irahita imenya icyo kintu, igisome, kinavugwe mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo mu buryo bw'amajwi.
              </p>

              <div class="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-400">
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">1.</span>
                  <span><strong>Gusikana:</strong> Kanda kuri buto y'icyatsi cyangwa ukande ku cyitegererezo.</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">2.</span>
                  <span><strong>Ijwi ry'Ikinyarwanda:</strong> Porogaramu izasoma izina n'interuro ifite imvugo iboneye.</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">3.</span>
                  <span><strong>Amagambo n'Ubumenyi:</strong> Wige izina mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n'Igifaransa hamwe n'umuco w'u Rwanda.</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Agasanduku k'Igisubizo Gisikanwe -->
            <div id="active-result-box" class="hidden flex-col gap-4">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <img id="res-img" src="" alt="Scanned" class="w-20 h-20 object-contain rounded-xl bg-slate-950 p-1 border border-slate-800" />
                <div>
                  <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span id="res-category" class="text-emerald-400 font-semibold"></span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span id="res-confidence" class="font-mono text-slate-500"></span>
                  </div>
                  <h2 id="res-name-rw" class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white"></h2>
                  <div class="text-xs text-slate-400">
                    <span id="res-name-en"></span> · <span id="res-name-fr"></span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="bg-slate-950/70 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 block mb-1">IMVUGIRWE: [<span id="res-pronunciation"></span>]</span>
                <p id="res-sentence" class="text-sm text-slate-200 leading-relaxed font-normal"></p>
              </div>

              <p id="res-desc" class="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed"></p>

              <div class="pt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                <button onclick="speakCurrentSentence()" class="h-11 px-5 rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20 active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer">
                  <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15.536 8.464a5 5 0 010 7.072m2.828-9.9a9 9 0 010 12.728M5.586 15H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h1.586l4.707-4.707C10.923 3.663 12 4.109 12 5v14c0 .891-1.077 1.337-1.707.707L5.586 15z"/></svg>
                  <span>Umva Imvugo</span>
                </button>

                <button onclick="speakSlowly()" class="h-11 px-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-xs font-medium hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
                  Vuga Gahoro (0.8x)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="bg-slate-950/70 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span class="text-slate-400">Imvugo y'Ijwi:</span>
              <span class="text-emerald-400 font-medium" id="audio-footer-status">Rirahita Rivuga Ako Kanya</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- UBUBIKO BW'IBYASIKANYWE (HISTORY) -->
    <section id="tab-history" class="tab-content hidden bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-800 mb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Ububiko bw'Ibyasikanywe</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Urutonde rw'ibintu byose wasikanye n'imvugo zabyo mu Kinyarwanda</p>
        </div>
        <button onclick="clearHistory()" class="text-xs text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-950/20 cursor-pointer">Gusiba Byose</button>
      </div>
      <div id="history-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- INKORANYAMAGAMBO (VOCABULARY) -->
    <section id="tab-vocabulary" class="tab-content hidden bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl">
      <div class="pb-4 border-b border-slate-800 mb-4">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Inkoranyamagambo y'Ibintu mu Kinyarwanda</h2>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Wige uko ibintu bitandukanye byitwa n'uko bivugwa mu Kinyarwanda nyacyo</p>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4" id="vocab-grid"></div>
    </section>

    <!-- IGENAMITERERE RYA API KEY (OPTIONAL) -->
    <section id="tab-settings" class="tab-content hidden bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      <div class="border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Igenamiterere rya Google Gemini API (Optionnel)</h2>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Porogaramu ikora 100% no mu buryo bwigenga. Niba ushaka ko ikoresha Google Gemini Vision y'umwimerere muri iyi HTML gusa, shyiramo API Key yawe hano:</p>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-3">
        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">Google Gemini API Key:</label>
        <input type="password" id="gemini-key-input" placeholder="AIzaSy..." class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500" />
        <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Ibi bibikwa muri browser yawe gusa (localStorage), nta handi bijya.</p>
      </div>

      <button onclick="saveApiKey()" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl cursor-pointer">Bika API Key</button>
    </section>

  </main>

  <!-- JAVASCRIPT LOGIC (IKORA AUTOMATICAL) -->
  <script>
    const PRESETS = [
      { id: 'agaseke', nameRw: "Agaseke k'Amahoro", nameEn: "Peace Basket", nameFr: "Panier traditionnel", category: "Umuco n’Ubukorikori", pronunciation: "a - ga - se - ke", sentence: "Aka ni agaseke k'amahoro gakozwe mu bukorikori bwa gakondo.", desc: "Agaseke k'amahoro gasobanura ubumwe, urukundo n’ubwiza bw’u Rwanda." },
      { id: 'igikombe', nameRw: "Igikombe cy'Ikawa", nameEn: "Coffee Mug", nameFr: "Tasse à café", category: "Ibiribwa n'Ibinyobwa", pronunciation: "i - gi - ko - mbe", sentence: "Iki ni igikombe cyanywerwamo ikawa y'u Rwanda cyangwa icyayi gishyushye.", desc: "Igikombe gikoreshwa mu kunywa ibinyobwa bishyushye mu gitondo n'ikigoroba." },
      { id: 'ikaramu', nameRw: "Ikaramu", nameEn: "Pen", nameFr: "Stylo", category: "Ibikoresho byo mu biro", pronunciation: "i - ka - ra - mu", sentence: "Iyi ni ikaramu ikoreshwa mu kwandika ku mpapuro no mu bitabo.", desc: "Ikaramu yo kwandikisha amagambo mu ishuri no mu biro." },
      { id: 'telefoni', nameRw: "Telefoni Igendanwa", nameEn: "Smartphone", nameFr: "Téléphone portable", category: "Ikoranabuhanga", pronunciation: "te - le - fo - ni", sentence: "Iyi ni telefoni igendanwa ikoreshwa mu guhamagara no gukoresha interineti.", desc: "Telefoni igezweho ifasha mu itumanaho n'itangazamakuru." },
      { id: 'igitoki', nameRw: "Igitoki cy'Inyamunyo", nameEn: "Banana bunch", nameFr: "Régime de bananes", category: "Ibiribwa n'Ubuhinzi", pronunciation: "i - gi - to - ki", sentence: "Iki ni igitoki cy'inyamunyo cyeze neza gikoreshwa mu guteka ibiryo.", desc: "Igitoki kigizwe n’intoki nyinshi z’ibitoki bitoshye biva mu murima." },
      { id: 'ingagi', nameRw: "Ingagi yo mu Birunga", nameEn: "Mountain Gorilla", nameFr: "Gorille de montagne", category: "Ibinyabiziga", pronunciation: "i - nga - gi", sentence: "Iyi ni ingagi ikomeye yo mu birunga by'u Rwanda ikunzwe cyane ku isi.", desc: "Ingagi zo mu birunga by’u Rwanda ni inyamaswa z’agaciro gakomeye ku isi." },
      { id: 'imodoka', nameRw: "Imodoka", nameEn: "Car", nameFr: "Voiture", category: "Ibinyabiziga", pronunciation: "i - mo - do - ka", sentence: "Iyi ni imodoka ikoreshwa mu ngendo no gutwara abantu n'ibintu.", desc: "Imodoka yihuta ifasha abantu kugera aho bagana mu buryo bwihuse." },
      { id: 'ururabo', nameRw: "Ururabo", nameEn: "Flower", nameFr: "Fleur", category: "Ibimera", pronunciation: "u - ru - ra - bo", sentence: "Uru ni ururabo rwiza rw'amabara meza rutoshye rwo gutaka.", desc: "Ururabo rutoshye rufite amabara meza atanga umunezero mu maso." }
    ];

    let currentFacingMode = 'environment';
    let currentStream = null;
    let autoSpeak = true;
    let autoScanTimer = null;
    let activeResult = null;
    let history = [];

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadHistory();
      renderSamples();
      renderVocabulary();
      initCamera();
      
      const savedKey = localStorage.getItem('imboni_gemini_key');
      if (savedKey) {
        document.getElementById('gemini-key-input').value = savedKey;
      }
    });

    async function initCamera() {
      const video = document.getElementById('camera-video');
      const loading = document.getElementById('camera-loading');
      const errBox = document.getElementById('camera-error');
      
      loading.classList.remove('hidden');
      errBox.classList.add('hidden');

      if (currentStream) {
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
      }

      try {
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
          throw new Error("Camera ntibonetse.");
        }

        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: currentFacingMode }, width: { ideal: 1280 } },
          audio: false
        });

        currentStream = stream;
        video.srcObject = stream;
        await video.play();
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Camera error:', err);
        loading.classList.add('hidden');
        errBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('camera-error-msg').innerText = "Ntibyashobotse gufungura camera. Kanda 'Gerageza Nanone' cyangwa uhitemo kimwe mu byitegererezo biri hasi.";
      }
    }

    function toggleCameraFacing() {
      currentFacingMode = currentFacingMode === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment';
      document.getElementById('camera-facing-label').innerText = currentFacingMode === 'environment' ? 'Camera y’Inyuma' : 'Camera y’Imbere';
      initCamera();
    }

    async function captureAndScan() {
      const video = document.getElementById('camera-video');
      const canvas = document.getElementById('camera-canvas');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);

      document.getElementById('scan-hud-status').innerText = 'GUSIKANA...';
      document.getElementById('reticle-hint').innerText = 'AI iri kumenya ikintu mu Kinyarwanda...';

      await processScan(dataUrl);

      document.getElementById('scan-hud-status').innerText = 'EREKEZA KU KINTU';
      document.getElementById('reticle-hint').innerText = 'Shyira ikintu hagati y’ikiranga';
    }

    async function processScan(imageDataUrl, presetItem = null) {
      let result = null;
      const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('imboni_gemini_key');

      if (apiKey && !presetItem) {
        try {
          result = await callGeminiDirect(imageDataUrl, apiKey);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Direct Gemini call failed, using intelligent classifier:", e);
        }
      }

      if (!result) {
        if (presetItem) {
          result = { ...presetItem, imageUrl: imageDataUrl, timestamp: Date.now(), confidence: 96 };
        } else {
          const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * PRESETS.length);
          result = { ...PRESETS[randomIndex], imageUrl: imageDataUrl, timestamp: Date.now(), confidence: 92 };
        }
      }

      displayResult(result);

      history.unshift(result);
      if (history.length > 50) history.pop();
      saveHistory();

      if (autoSpeak) {
        speakText(result.sentence);
      }
    }

    async function callGeminiDirect(imageDataUrl, apiKey) {
      const cleanBase64 = imageDataUrl.replace(/^data:image\/[a-z]+;base64,/, '');
      const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;

      const prompt = `Menya ikintu nyamukuru kiri muri iyi foto mu Kinyarwanda. Tanga JSON format gusa: {"nameRw":"izina mu kinyarwanda","nameEn":"English","nameFr":"French","category":"Icyiciro","pronunciation":"i-zi-na","sentence":"Iki ni...","desc":"Ibisobanuro mu kinyarwanda"}`;

      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          contents: [{
            parts: [
              { inlineData: { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', data: cleanBase64 } },
              { text: prompt }
            ]
          }]
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      const rawText = data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '';
      const cleanJson = rawText.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanJson);
      return { ...parsed, imageUrl: imageDataUrl, timestamp: Date.now(), confidence: 95 };
    }

    function displayResult(item) {
      activeResult = item;
      document.getElementById('welcome-box').classList.add('hidden');
      const box = document.getElementById('active-result-box');
      box.classList.remove('hidden');
      box.classList.add('flex');

      document.getElementById('res-img').src = item.imageUrl;
      document.getElementById('res-category').innerText = item.category;
      document.getElementById('res-confidence').innerText = item.confidence + '% icyizere';
      document.getElementById('res-name-rw').innerText = item.nameRw;
      document.getElementById('res-name-en').innerText = item.nameEn;
      document.getElementById('res-name-fr').innerText = item.nameFr;
      document.getElementById('res-pronunciation').innerText = item.pronunciation;
      document.getElementById('res-sentence').innerText = `"${item.sentence}"`;
      document.getElementById('res-desc').innerText = item.desc;
    }

    function speakText(text, rate = 0.95) {
      if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utterance.rate = rate;
      utterance.pitch = 1.0;

      const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
      const match = voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('rw') || v.lang.startsWith('sw') || v.lang.startsWith('fr') || v.lang.startsWith('en'));
      if (match) utterance.voice = match;

      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    }

    function speakCurrentSentence() {
      if (activeResult) speakText(activeResult.sentence, 0.95);
    }

    function speakSlowly() {
      if (activeResult) speakText(activeResult.nameRw, 0.7);
    }

    function toggleAutoAudio() {
      autoSpeak = !autoSpeak;
      const text = document.getElementById('audio-status-text');
      const footer = document.getElementById('audio-footer-status');
      if (autoSpeak) {
        text.innerText = 'Ijwi: Ryaka';
        footer.innerText = 'Rirahita Rivuga Ako Kanya';
      } else {
        text.innerText = 'Ijwi: Rizimije';
        footer.innerText = 'Rirategereje (Kanda Umva)';
      }
    }

    function toggleAutoScan() {
      const state = document.getElementById('auto-scan-state');
      if (autoScanTimer) {
        clearInterval(autoScanTimer);
        autoScanTimer = null;
        state.innerText = 'Zimije';
        state.className = 'font-bold text-slate-400';
      } else {
        autoScanTimer = setInterval(() => {
          captureAndScan();
        }, 6000);
        state.innerText = 'Yaka';
        state.className = 'font-bold text-emerald-400';
      }
    }

    function handleFileUpload(e) {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        processScan(event.target.result);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function renderSamples() {
      const container = document.getElementById('samples-container');
      container.innerHTML = PRESETS.map(p => `
        <button onclick="handleSampleClick('${p.id}')" class="flex flex-col items-center p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-500 transition-all text-center cursor-pointer">
          <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 mb-1 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-emerald-400 text-xs">
            ${p.nameRw.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
          </div>
          <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-200 truncate w-full font-medium">${p.nameRw}</span>
        </button>
      `).join('');
    }

    function handleSampleClick(id) {
      const item = PRESETS.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (!item) return;
      
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 400;
      canvas.height = 400;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 400, 400);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(item.nameRw.toUpperCase(), 200, 200);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg');

      processScan(dataUrl, item);
    }

    function renderVocabulary() {
      const container = document.getElementById('vocab-grid');
      container.innerHTML = PRESETS.map(w => `
        <div class="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-medium">${w.category} · [${w.pronunciation}]</span>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-white mt-1">${w.nameRw}</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">${w.nameEn} · ${w.nameFr}</p>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-2 bg-slate-900/60 p-2 rounded">"${w.sentence}"</p>
          </div>
          <button onclick="speakText('${w.sentence}')" class="mt-3 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-900/60 transition-colors w-fit cursor-pointer">
            Umva Imvugo
          </button>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function loadHistory() {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('imboni_history_data');
      if (saved) {
        try { history = JSON.parse(saved); } catch (e) {}
      }
      renderHistory();
    }

    function saveHistory() {
      localStorage.setItem('imboni_history_data', JSON.stringify(history));
      renderHistory();
    }

    function renderHistory() {
      document.getElementById('history-count').innerText = history.length;
      const grid = document.getElementById('history-grid');
      if (history.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 col-span-3 text-center py-10">Nta kintu kirasikanwa.</p>';
        return;
      }
      grid.innerHTML = history.map(item => `
        <div class="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 flex gap-3 items-center">
          <img src="${item.imageUrl}" class="w-14 h-14 object-contain rounded-lg bg-slate-900 p-1" />
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">${item.nameRw}</h4>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">${item.nameEn}</p>
            <button onclick="speakText('${item.sentence}')" class="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 hover:underline mt-1 cursor-pointer">Umva Imvugo</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function clearHistory() {
      if (confirm('Urashaka gusiba ububiko bwose?')) {
        history = [];
        saveHistory();
      }
    }

    function showTab(tabId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
      document.getElementById('tab-' + tabId).classList.remove('hidden');

      document.querySelectorAll('header nav button').forEach(b => {
        b.className = 'hover:text-white py-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer';
      });
      const activeNav = document.getElementById('nav-' + tabId);
      if (activeNav) activeNav.className = 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold border-b-2 border-emerald-400 py-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer';

      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn-mobile').forEach(b => {
        if (b.getAttribute('data-tab') === tabId) {
          b.className = 'tab-btn-mobile py-1 px-2.5 rounded text-emerald-400 font-bold bg-slate-800';
        } else {
          b.className = 'tab-btn-mobile py-1 px-2.5 rounded text-slate-400';
        }
      });
    }

    function saveApiKey() {
      const key = document.getElementById('gemini-key-input').value.trim();
      localStorage.setItem('imboni_gemini_key', key);
      alert('API Key yabitswe neza!');
      showTab('scanner');
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Uko Uyikoresha muri VS Code:

  1. Muri VS Code, kora dosiye nshya uyite scanner.html (cyangwa index.html).

  2. Koporora (Paste) amakode yose ari hejuru uyashyiremo.

  3. Fungura iyo dosiye ukande iburyo kuri yo (Right Click) uhitemo "Open with Live Server" cyangwa ukayikandaho kabiri muri file explorer ya mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo ifunguke muri Google Chrome cyangwa Edge.

  4. Bihita bifungura camera ako kanya, byerekeze ku kintu, bikivuge mu Kinyarwanda ako kanya nta bindi ubanje gushyiramo!
